items.title: TiPMC: new ex-Venator capacity may cap TiO2 price gains; India duty supports regional pricing
items.text: PCI Magazine, reporting TiPMC Consulting's Fall 2026 forecast, puts global TiO2 demand at 7.37 million t in 2026 (+1.1%) and 7.61 million t in 2027 (+3.2%). Former Venator plants at Greatham, Huelva and Scarlino (about 310,000 t/yr) are returning, and TiPMC expects Chinese chloride-process expansion to continue. It cites India's renewed anti-dumping duty as supporting regional pricing, but says duties can also redirect Chinese exports to markets with fewer restrictions. For Indian producers such as Meghmani, the duty helps, but global oversupply could limit realisations.
